titre: Information security: Neur.on receives ISO 27001 certification
texte:
in your view, what is the main concern of companies in LegalTech and FinTech when working with new suppliers? Based on our experience, it is information security.

After all, in these sectors, processing customer data according to protocols is not a gadget advantage. This is absolutely essential.

and even if our smiling faces do not let him guess, we take this subject very seriously. To such an extent that we have obtained ISO 27001 certification.

ISO 27001 is an international standard for the implementation, maintenance and improvement of WSIS (information security management systems).

our access, storage and information protection processes have been carefully controlled by an official third party body.

and as you can imagine, we will not stop there: this T-shirt is only the first of our security fashionista wardrobe. Others will soon be printed. Because it security is already embedded in everything we do.

titre: Legaltechtalk 2024 in London: 3 insights into the reinvention of law firms
texte:
How law firms are reimagining their business model and relationship with legal directors: 3 pins delivered by legal Innovation panelists to LegalTechTalk 2024 in London.

  • invest in and develop the relationship between internal legal teams or legal directors and external counsel. This is the easiest way to get practical and proactive legal advice.
  • Analyse your processes and data to achieve marginal efficiency gains. To innovate in a law firm, start with low-risk areas, then gradually switch to more complex processes.
  • Create multidisciplinary teams, bringing together the main departments concerned, to meet customer requirements and provide a global experience.

These lessons are offered to you by James Lane, Jordan Lee and line Lolk Thomsen, with whom Neur.on CEO Paula Reichenberg discussed “How Law firms invent their operating models and relationships with General Counsels”.

titre: Neur.on wins the Swiss FinTech Awards 2024 in the early stage category
texte:
like a return home …

Yesterday evening, the jury of Swiss FinTech Awards 2024 has named Neur.on winner of the early-stage Startup category.

But at the Swiss FinTech Awards it was different.

here, we felt that the whole room UNDERSTOOD us. The people present knew that a regular online translation service cannot guarantee either a secure platform for client data or a language specific to the financial and legal markets and commensurate with the professionalism they are given.

Thank you, Swiss FinTech Awards, for this warm feeling of being at last with us!

titre: AI for translation in administration: Neur.on Sandbox innovation
texte:

in this Sandbox innovation, Paula Reichenberg, CEO and founder of Neur.on, and Simona Todesco, COO of Textshuttle, together with Raphael von Thiessen, explain the challenges of legal translations with specialised artificial intelligence and show how to produce secure and adaptable automatic translations.

Just look at: https://youtu.be/yZKDzhTlfcA

L 'Innovation Sandbox for artificial Intelligence is an initiative in which administration, business and research work together on regulatory issues and allow the use of new types of data sources. titre: Paula Reichenberg, Vice-President of SLTA, at the 2023 training Day in the OAF
texte:
in her capacity as Vice-President of the Swiss LegalTech Association (SLTA), the CEO of Neur.on, Paula Reichenberg, participated in the 2023 OAF training Day organised by the Fribourg Bar Association on Friday 1 December 2023.

This event, organised by the Fribourg Bar Association (OAF), provided legal professionals with a practical overview of several key topics, including the implications of the new data Protection Act for law firms and good data management practices.

the workshop answered specific questions: how long do law firms have to keep their clients' records, is it permissible to use client data to trigger AI, and how to set up cookies banners on websites.

through this event, SLTA, Fribourg Section, has reaffirmed its desire to provide clear and precise answers to complex and uncertain legal questions.

to what the speakers say:

Michael Montavon , doctor of Law, legal Counsel at the Law Department of the State of Fribourg, lecturer in e-government, data protection and legistics.

Paula Reichenberg, lic. iur. Fribourg, lawyer registered with the Zurich bar, CEO and founder of Neur.on AI Solutions, Vice-President of the Swiss LegalTech Association and Digital shaper 2023.

titre: Paula Reichenberg joins the Industrial Board of the Swiss AI Center for SMEs (CSIA-PME)
texte:

for a committed start-up founder and CEO of LegalTech, accepting additional responsibility is not self-evident.

However, the Swiss AI Center, co-founded by Professor Jean Hennebert to serve small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) as well as ICT start-ups, takes such a pragmatic and entrepreneur-centric approach that Paula was convinced that she would be able to contribute simply by raising awareness of the enormous needs of innovative companies in Switzerland: data sovereignty and corresponding Swiss GPU infrastructure, transparency of sources and data streams related to generative AI, as well as clear and business-consistent guidelines and rules for AI certification, to name but a few.

titre: Neur.on at the LegalTech summer Eve in Geneva: AI will not change THE profession of lawyer!
texte:
This evening, Geneva lawyers exchange views on LegalTech with the craftsmen of their favourite tools, EyeTeK and Neur.on.

among the “disruptive dissertations” presented tonight, a particularly perilous and tempting assertion:

AI will NOT change the profession

Why? Because AI above all excels in tasks:

  • that lawyers do NOT LIKE to run (consistency check footnotes);
  • that lawyers do NOT HAVE TIME to make (tagger and summarize articles of interest to them);
  • that some do NOT KNOW how to do well (spelling, grammar, translation).

texte:

The generalist and accessible nature of these solutions has awakened the interest of all sectors, including those considered more conservative, such as the legal profession. Lawyers are looking for secure solutions tailored by experienced specialists to meet their needs and processes.

This is where Neur.on comes in. In two Innosuisse projects, we combine proprietary algorithms and a carefully constructed data corpus within human-in-the-loop processes, in order to provide innovative specialized AI capabilities in the field of LegalTech.

titre: Innosuisse funds research and development of the Neur.on translation SaaS
texte:
SWISS FUNDS FOR A SWITZERLAND: Innosuisse, the Swiss Innovation Promotion Agency, recently granted us new funding for research and development of the SaaS legal and Financial Translation of Neur.on.

the Innosuisse-supported Neur.on research project will be carried out in collaboration with Institute iCoSys (Institute of complete systems) of Fribourg University of Engineering and Architecture (HEIA-FR), with the aim of providing secure, reliable and efficient AI translation to Switzerland as well as to the rest of the world.

We will apply innovative zero-shot and few-shot learning approaches to specialized legal and financial NLP models, effectively integrating user feedback when reviewing the results of machine translation.

Thanks to this funding, we will be able to further develop the technical tools needed to create complex, simple and accessible AI translation tools for law and finance professionals.

Thank Innosuisse for its support!

titre: What asset lawyers expect from LegalTech: Neur.on at the LAM conference
texte:

In the face of a constantly evolving regulatory environment and unclear definitions of compliance, and linking contractual work with internal legal issues, asset managers would need all the help that technology can provide.

What LegalTech tools can be put in place immediately to achieve better, faster and cost-effective outcomes?

at 'S invitation} Hinsen Andreas and Julien Cayet, Loyens & Loeff, our CEO, Paula Reichenberg, and Jordan Urstadt, PartnerVine, concrete solutions and usage cases were presented at the inaugural lawyers in Asset Management (LAM) conference, co-organized with Aruna Arasu, Alpha Associates, and Nicky Walsh, Astra legal.
